message.name: BuyerProtectionInstructionV01
message.definition: Scope|The BuyeProtectionInstruction message is sent by an account owner to an account servicer to instruct a buyer protection on a pending settlement instruction.|||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR (Other) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN (Change) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM (Final Maturity) must only be used if the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: OfficialCorporateActionEventReference
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the structure and usage of the Official Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF). These recommendations are|available in the SMPG Global Market Practices Part 1 document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: AdditionalInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition as in NarrativeVersion.

rules.name: MarketInfrastructureOrProcessorTransactionIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentification or ProcessorTransactionIdentification must be present, both may be present.

rules.name: GenericCashPricePerProductGuideline
rules.text: Generic Cash Price Received per Product (OFFR) and Generic Cash Price Paid per Product (PRPP) are prices received or paid in the course of an event. The specific meaning (redemption price, subscription price, reinvestment price, etc.) is derived from the event type.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
